onboarding_welcome_subtitle: Let's get you protected in about a minute.
onboarding_welcome_body: Ace Blocker sits between your browser and the internet. It filters what you asked it to filter, and makes what slips through far less rewarding.
onboarding_welcome_point_block: Block entire categories of sites, or just the handful that keep pulling you in.
onboarding_welcome_point_resist: Make the sites you cannot fully cut out slower, greyer and duller.
onboarding_welcome_point_track: Watch the dashboard show what Ace Blocker is stopping for you.
onboarding_concept_blocks: A network block combines categories and websites with a schedule. When enabled, it enforces those rules during its scheduled hours.
onboarding_concept_site_packs: Categories are curated sets of known sites. Choose one to cover thousands of domains without maintaining a list yourself.
onboarding_concept_resistance: Resistance Mode makes distracting sites less rewarding by changing how they look or behave, for example by removing endless feeds or slowing videos.
onboarding_blocks_subtitle: Choose which starter blocks to enable.
onboarding_blocks_body: Selecting a block enables its protection using its configured schedule. New starter blocks cover all hours; you can customize schedules later.
onboarding_blocks_footnote: Nothing here is permanent. You can edit, schedule or delete any block from the Network Blocks page.
onboarding_resistance_subtitle: For the sites you cannot block outright.
onboarding_resistance_body: Some sites you need, but not for three hours. Resistance mode strips the colour, slows the video and removes the infinite feed, so visiting stops being a reward.
onboarding_resistance_toggle_hint: Starts at the gentlest level. You can raise or lower the intensity any time.
onboarding_resistance_footnote: Fine-tune which scripts run, and how aggressive they are, on the Resistance Mode page.
onboarding_done_subtitle: Here is where to go next.
onboarding_done_body: Your dashboard shows which blocks are protecting you and how many sites were blocked today. Take the quick tour to find your way around, or read the guide whenever you like.
onboarding_take_tour_hint: A two-minute walk through the app.

tour_create_block_body: Create a block for anything the defaults do not cover — a single site, a work-hours rule, whatever you need.
tour_site_packs_body: Curated coverage for thousands of known sites. Choose categories instead of maintaining domain lists by hand.
tour_resistance_mode_body: Choose which scripts degrade the sites you still visit, and how aggressive they get.

guide_subtitle: Everything you need to set up Ace Blocker properly.
guide_replay_description: The setup wizard changes your configuration. The tour only shows you where things are.
guide_concepts_description: The five ideas the whole app is built on.
guide_concept_blocks_body: A block combines categories or specific websites with a schedule and a lock. When its schedule is active, those targets are blocked.
guide_concept_site_packs_body: Curated categories cover thousands of known domains and stay up to date for you. Custom Lists let you bring your own domain collection.
guide_concept_schedules_body: A block only blocks while its schedule says so. No schedule means no blocking — that is why new blocks start inert.
guide_concept_locks_body: A lock stops you from weakening a block while it is on: no deleting, no new exceptions, no shrinking the schedule.
guide_concept_resistance_body: Injects scripts into sites you still visit — greyscale, slower video, no infinite feed — so they stop feeling rewarding.
guide_setup_description: Five steps to a configuration that holds.
guide_step_pick_blocks_title: Turn on the blocks you need
guide_step_pick_blocks_body: Open Network Blocks and switch on the pre-built blocks that match what you are avoiding. Each one arrives with category coverage or specific website rules.
guide_step_add_rules_body: Add a domain like 'example.com' for a site the categories do not cover. Use advanced matching with a regular expression only when you need finer control.
guide_step_schedule_body: Decide when the block is live. All day every day is the strongest option; work hours only is a common gentler start.
guide_step_lock_body: A lock is what makes the block survive a moment of weakness. Start with a soft-unlockable lock if you are not ready to commit.
guide_step_resistance_body: For sites you cannot block outright, pick which scripts run and how hard they push. Start low and raise it as you adjust.
guide_faq_description: Short answers to the things people ask first.
guide_faq_why_blocked_question: Why is a site I need being blocked?
guide_faq_why_blocked_answer: A category or Custom List probably matches it. Open the block, add the domain as an exception, and it will be allowed while the rest of that coverage stays blocked.
guide_faq_unblock_question: How do I stop blocking something?
guide_faq_unblock_answer: Remove the specific website rule, detach the category or Custom List, or narrow the block's schedule. If the block is locked, you will have to wait for the lock to end or complete its unlock challenge first.
guide_faq_locked_out_question: I locked myself out. Now what?
guide_faq_locked_out_answer: Timed locks stay in place until their end time. If you chose a lock with an unlock challenge, follow the steps shown to request early access.
guide_faq_certificate_question: Why does Ace install a certificate?
guide_faq_certificate_answer: Ace uses a certificate on your device to inspect supported HTTPS browser traffic and apply your protections. This inspection happens locally; websites still receive the traffic you send them.
guide_faq_privacy_answer: Your browsing history stays local. The engine only talks to our servers to check your subscription and download category data and script updates.
guide_still_stuck_description: The support team reads every message. Send us the details and we will help.
